name: @kolivri/memoria-mcp
description: Official Node.js MCP connector for Memoria Cloud (https://memoria.kolivri.com) — deterministic long-term memory, cross-session recall, and code intelligence for Claude Code, OpenCode, Cursor, Windsurf, VS Code, and Claude Desktop.

tools.name: encode_memory
tools.description: Store a new memory with tier classification (episodic, semantic, buffer, core), salience weight, and key-value context metadata.

tools.name: batch_encode
tools.description: Encode multiple memories atomically in a single batch call.

tools.name: recall_memories
tools.description: Retrieve relevant memories ranked deterministically by BM25, salience, tier weight, feedback utility, and temporal freshness.

tools.name: build_context
tools.description: Assemble a token-budgeted <memory_context> block combining Core rules, Semantic facts, and Episodic history for session grounding.

tools.name: forget_memory
tools.description: Delete a specific memory and its incident graph edges by ID.

tools.name: delete_by_context
tools.description: Delete all memories matching a specific context metadata [key, value] pair.

tools.name: feedback
tools.description: Record whether a recalled memory was useful and adjust its salience score.

tools.name: consolidate
tools.description: Deduplicate memories within a namespace, link superseded records, and promote recurring high-salience episodic memories to Semantic tier.

tools.name: health
tools.description: Return Memoria engine health, storage status, tier distribution, and cloud sync mode.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Return detailed memory, edge, and tier statistics for a namespace.

tools.name: search_code
tools.description: Search indexed code definitions and workspace source files by symbol or query, returning ranked definitions with file and line numbers.

tools.name: explain_code
tools.description: Explain a code symbol: where it is defined, who references it across the workspace, related tests, and associated architectural memories.

tools.name: list_agent_wings
tools.description: List specialist multi-agent wings (architect, reviewer, qa, security, ops), their active memory counts, and recent handoffs.

tools.name: handoff_to_agent
tools.description: Hand off task context, architectural findings, and selected memory IDs from one specialist agent wing to another.
